newsitem.title: USA: First Midwest acquires Security State.
newsitem.headline: First Midwest acquires Security State.

text.p: First Midwest Financial Inc said Tuesday it acquired Security State Bank of Stuart, Iowa for about $5.3 million in cash and 171,158 shares. Security was a subsidiary of Central West Bancorp
First Midwest said it acquired all of Central West's 72,750 outstanding shares, paying $18.04 a share and issuing a total of 2.3528 shares of its common stock for each Central West share.
At June 30, Security State Bank had assets of $29.9 million and First Midwest Financial had assets of $342.1 million.
